chunks: Muḥammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام that he said:

The one performing salat has three qualities: when he stands in his salat, the angels surround him from his feet to the heights of the sky, goodness scatters upon him from the heights of the sky to the parting of his head, and an angel appointed over him calls out: if the one performing salat knew whom he is intimately conversing with, he would not turn away.

key_terms.الْبِرُّ: goodness and blessing bestowed upon the worshipper
key_terms.الْمَلَائِكَةُ: the angels who surround the worshipper

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the spiritual reality of standing in salat?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the immense spiritual state of a person standing in salat. It teaches that prayer is surrounded by angelic presence, divine goodness, and intimate nearness to Allah, such that true awareness of this reality would keep the worshipper fully engaged.
